claims.text: Dash is a cryptocurrency designed for payments (digital cash), built on Bitcoin-derived technology.
Dash is a two-tier network: a layer-1 blockchain of miners, plus a second tier of masternodes providing extra services.
A masternode is a collateralized node (1,000 DASH) on the second tier; unlike ordinary full nodes it is paid to provide the network's extra services.
Masternodes are the one addition that makes Dash's differentiating features possible, including fast confirmation of payments.
Dash payments settle/confirm in about a second, so a recipient does not wait for several block confirmations.
Instant confirmation is applied automatically to qualifying transactions at no extra cost.
Dash's smallest unit is the duff; 1 Dash equals 100,000,000 duffs.
Dash Core is the layer-1 blockchain/reference client used for payments.
Dash has a second job in addition to money: Dash Platform, a decentralized data/application layer built on top of the same network.
Drive (storage) and DAPI (a decentralized API) are Dash Platform's core components.
Evonodes are masternodes with 4,000 DASH collateral that host Dash Platform in addition to Core; regular masternodes (1,000 DASH) serve only Core.
Masternodes/evonodes are compensated for their work, reflecting their collateral and role.
One network runs both jobs: the money chain (Core) and the data layer (Platform) share the same masternode/evonode infrastructure.

uncertainties.topic: How precisely to word the one-second confirmation given docs mix 'instant' and 'little more than a second'
uncertainties.resolution: Lesson uses 'about a second' to match the manifest, and names the effect only — no locking-protocol machinery.

uncertainties.topic: Whether to name InstantSend/ChainLocks, which are the mechanism behind one-second confirmation
uncertainties.resolution: The lesson names the effect ('payments confirm in about a second') and does not name the locking protocols; the machinery is a later lesson's job.

uncertainties.topic: Whether to include precise reward-split percentages or Platform fee percentages in a concepts lesson
uncertainties.resolution: The lesson says masternodes/evonodes are collateralized and paid, without citing contingent reward-split percentages.

uncertainties.topic: How far 'masternodes make the rest possible' should reach into governance/DAO/treasury
uncertainties.resolution: Governance is left for module 4; 'the rest' is restricted to fast payments and Dash Platform.
